questions.q: What can a chatbot do for a restaurant?
questions.a: A restaurant chatbot answers common guest questions about hours, menus and reservations instantly, on your website, social channels or messaging apps. Some also take bookings, capture catering leads, run promotions or answer phone calls with voice AI. That frees your team from repetitive questions so they can focus on guests in the room.

questions.q: How do I choose the right chatbot for my restaurant?
questions.a: Start with where your guests reach out most, whether that's your website, Instagram, WhatsApp, the phone or review sites. Then check whether the tool connects to your reservation system, POS and loyalty program, and how easily your team can set it up. Groups with developers can build custom bots, while most restaurants are better served by a ready-made tool.

questions.q: Can an AI chatbot reply to restaurant reviews?
questions.a: Yes, some platforms built for restaurants use AI agents to reply to reviews as well as messages. Momos's Alfie answers guests across review sites, social channels, messaging and delivery apps in your brand voice, and can issue loyalty rewards during recovery. When a person is needed, it hands the ticket to your team with the full conversation and a suggested next step.

questions.q: Will a chatbot replace my restaurant staff?
questions.a: A chatbot handles routine questions and after-hours requests, which lets your staff spend more time on guests and complex issues. Good tools escalate to a person when a situation calls for it. Many operators use them to make their existing team more productive.

Costs vary widely, from free plans for simple website chat to custom pricing for enterprise platforms. Developer platforms can also add AI usage fees on top of the subscription. It's worth comparing the price against the time saved and the reservations or orders the tool helps you capture.
